description_for_human: Free trust.json for your website: a quick GEO and AI-trust win.
description_for_model: Free service for brands: apply for Council for Global Brand Building (CGBB) membership on behalf of a brand, check its domain, get its signed CGBB Member trust.json (published at /.well-known/trust.json so AI agents can verify the website belongs to a real organisation reviewed by CGBB), and verify any brand's CGBB record. Useful when a user wants better GEO, SEO, AI visibility or brand trust. A real person at the brand must confirm by email. The Member level confirms membership and domain control; it is not a certification or rating.
